field_guide.mapping: Defines all element types (terrain and interactive objects), where the key is a single-character representation of the element.
field_guide.terrain: Single-tile terrain layer. Each character in each row string of the grid array directly corresponds to a key in mapping
field_guide.interaction: Multi-tile interactive object layer. The anchor represents the top-left corner coordinate of the area occupied by the object, and the object extends size-specified tiles to the right (+x) and downward (+y) from that point. Includes: id (unique identifier), category (category), element (references mapping key), anchor (top-left corner coordinates {x,y}), size (occupied tiles {width,height})
field_guide.collision: Collision type for physics behavior. prevent: no collision detection or events; Passive: triggers collision events only, no physical response; Active: full collision with movement response; Fixed: immovable solid object that blocks Active bodies

X.name: space
X.description: empty area, all entities can pass through freely, no collision detection

B.name: ground
B.description: solid terrain, blocks player/enemy movement, player can stand and walk on top

S.name: breakable brick
S.description: destructible block, blocks player/enemy movement, player can stand on top, destroyed when player hits from below (big mario only), small mario bounces off

?.name: question block
?.description: interactive block, blocks player/enemy movement, player can stand on top, releases item (coin/mushroom/star) when player hits from below, becomes empty solid block after activation

E.name: enemy
E.description: hostile entity, moves horizontally and reverses on collision with obstacles, damages player on side contact, destroyed when player jumps on top, collides with ground/pipe/brick

o.name: coin
o.description: collectible item, player can pass through and collect on contact, adds score, no collision with enemy/projectile

P.name: pipe
P.description: solid obstacle, blocks player/enemy movement, player can stand on top, some pipes allow player to enter by pressing down

C.name: cannon
C.description: hostile structure, blocks player/enemy movement, player can stand on top, periodically fires bullet toward player direction

M.name: moving platform
M.description: dynamic solid surface, moves horizontally between two points, player/enemy can stand and ride on top, passes through other terrain

^.name: mushroom
^.description: power-up item, spawns from question block, moves horizontally and reverses on obstacle collision, player collects on contact and transforms to big mario, falls with gravity

J.name: springboard
J.description: bouncy platform, player can stand on top, launches player high into air when player jumps on it, bounce height depends on jump timing, blocks horizontal movement

L.name: player
L.description: player controlled character, moves left/right and jumps, affected by gravity, collides with ground/brick/pipe/enemy, can stomp enemies from above, collects coins and power-ups on contact

X.name: space
X.description: empty area, player and enemies can move through freely, player falls through if no ground below, allows projectile passage

L.name: ground
L.description: solid terrain, player can stand and walk on top, blocks movement from sides and below, defines level boundaries and platforms

Q.name: falling_spike
Q.description: ceiling hazard, drops vertically when player approaches, instantly kills player on contact, falls through platforms, respawns after leaving screen

T.name: terrain_trap
T.description: environmental hazard, instantly kills player on contact, some traps can be jumped over, blocks ground movement, player projectiles pass through

S.name: spring
S.description: bouncy platform, launches player high into air, allows reaching elevated areas

V.name: vertical_platform
V.description: moving platform traveling up and down

H.name: horizontal_platform
H.description: moving platform traveling left and right

E.name: enemy
E.description: kills player on contact, can be defeated by projectile

B.name: boss
B.description: has high health requiring multiple hits

O.name: goal
O.description: level exit marker, player reaches to complete current stage
